summary: Small sealed gardens car park in bush, no homes nearby; pin itself is on a footpath.
reasons: Car park ringed by bush and gardens

drivers.seclusion: Bush on both sides of the road, gardens to the east, no dwellings mapped or visible.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road reaches a car park with about six marked bays and a pull-in; mapped access yes, no fee. Ring itself is on a garden footpath, not drivable.
drivers.traffic: Quiet gardens access road, no through traffic apart from visitors.
drivers.convention: Two cars parked in the bays. Yellow edge lines along the road mean no kerbside stopping. Public car park for gardens visitors, not an overnight site.

flags: Slope figure is for the ring area (about 9% mean); car park itself not sampled
Yellow edge lines along the road: stop only in the car park
Botanic gardens car park may be gated or patrolled after hours
Small: only a handful of bays
sun_shade: Partly open to the sky; trees to the north and east give some shade, afternoon sun from the west over the road.
cannot_judge: Closing hours or night gate on the gardens road
Signs on site (time limits, no camping)
Level of the car park surface

best_section.where: Small sealed car park on the east side of the gardens road, about 60 m south of the ring
